# stb_truetype

Single-header TrueType rasterizer by Sean Barrett.

- Version: v1.26
- Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb
- License: public domain or MIT (see the header of `stb_truetype.h`)

Used for baking the UI font atlas. No modifications have been made to the header.

`stb_image.h` is vendored from commit `d14d46f6b44456eb88beac58cba833a4135d4c89`
of the same upstream repository under its dual public-domain/MIT license. Lucid
builds only its in-memory PNG decoder for visual regression screenshots.
